sentences.content: Good evening, everyone!
sentences.english: Good evening , everyone !
sentences.chinese: 大家晚上好！

sentences.content: Our guest today is Dr Pete Roberts, author of the best-selling book Ready for Tomorrow.
sentences.english: Our guest today is Dr Pete Roberts , author of the best-selling book Ready for Tomorrow
sentences.chinese: 今天的嘉宾是畅销书《为明天做好准备》的作者Pete Roberts博士。

sentences.content: So welcome to our show, Dr Roberts.
sentences.english: So welcome to our show , Dr Roberts
sentences.chinese: 欢迎来到我们的节目，Roberts博士。

sentences.content: Good evening.
sentences.english: Good evening
sentences.chinese: 晚上好。

sentences.content: Thank you, it’s a pleasure to be here.
sentences.english: Thank you , it's a pleasure to be here
sentences.chinese: 谢谢，很荣幸来到这里。

sentences.content: Dr Roberts, thank you for joining us.
sentences.english: Dr Roberts , thank you for joining us
sentences.chinese: Roberts博士，感谢您加入我们。

sentences.content: So, as a futurist, can you tell us how life will be different in 50 years?
sentences.english: So , as a futurist , can you tell us how life will be different in 50 years ?
sentences.chinese: 那么，作为一位未来学家，您能否告诉我们50年后的生活会有哪些不同？

sentences.content: Well, you’ll see robots working everywhere.
sentences.english: Well , you'll see robots working everywhere
sentences.chinese: 嗯，你会看到机器人无处不在。

sentences.content: Can you give us some examples?
sentences.english: Can you give us some examples ?
sentences.chinese: 能否给我们举些例子？

sentences.content: Well, we’ll have service robots.
sentences.english: Well , we'll have service robots
sentences.chinese: 嗯，我们会有服务机器人。

sentences.content: They will do almost all our housework.
sentences.english: They will do almost all our housework
sentences.chinese: 他们将承担我们几乎所有的家务。

sentences.content: They will also help save lives when disasters and emergencies happen.
sentences.english: They will also help save lives when disasters and emergencies happen
sentences.chinese: 在灾难和紧急情况发生时，他们还将帮助挽救生命。

sentences.content: So, what jobs will humans still do in the future?
sentences.english: So , what jobs will humans still do in the future ?
sentences.chinese: 那么，未来人类还将从事哪些工作呢？

sentences.content: Good question!
sentences.english: Good question !
sentences.chinese: 问得好！

sentences.content: Some jobs today will disappear in the coming years.
sentences.english: Some jobs today will disappear in the coming years
sentences.chinese: 如今的一些工作将在未来几年内消失。

wordDetails.definition: come（现在分词）: 即将到来的

sentences.content: However, there will be more challenging jobs in the future, such as space pilots and AI experts.
sentences.english: However , there will be more challenging jobs in the future , such as space pilots and AI experts
sentences.chinese: 然而，未来将会出现更具挑战性的职业，例如太空飞行员和AI专家。

sentences.content: Do you think robots will replace humans one day?
sentences.english: Do you think robots will replace humans one day ?
sentences.chinese: 你认为机器人有一天会取代人类吗？

sentences.content: No, I don’t.
sentences.english: No , I don't
sentences.chinese: 不，我不。

sentences.content: Our creativity and emotional intelligence are important for relationships.
sentences.english: Our creativity and emotional intelligence are important for relationships
sentences.chinese: 我们的创造力和情商对人际关系至关重要。

sentences.content: AI will not replace humans for these things.
sentences.english: AI will not replace humans for these things
sentences.chinese: 人工智能无法在这些领域取代人类。

sentences.content: You mentioned AI.
sentences.english: You mentioned AI
sentences.chinese: 你提到了人工智能。

sentences.content: How will AI change our world?
sentences.english: How will AI change our world ?
sentences.chinese: 人工智能将如何改变我们的世界？

sentences.content: It will change the world in many ways.
sentences.english: It will change the world in many ways
sentences.chinese: 它将在诸多方面改变世界。

sentences.content: For example, we won’t need to go to the supermarket.
sentences.english: For example , we won't need to go to the supermarket
sentences.chinese: 例如，我们就不必去超市了。

sentences.content: Smart refrigerators will understand our needs.
sentences.english: Smart refrigerators will understand our needs
sentences.chinese: 智能冰箱将能理解我们的需求。

sentences.content: When we are almost out of some food, they will order it for us.
sentences.english: When we are almost out of some food , they will order it for us
sentences.chinese: 当我们某种食物快吃完时，他们会帮我们订购。

sentences.content: Wow, that’ll save us a lot of time!
sentences.english: Wow , that'll save us a lot of time !
sentences.chinese: 哇，这下可省了我们不少时间！

sentences.content: Now, my last question: How can we prepare for the future?
sentences.english: Now , my last question : How can we prepare for the future ?
sentences.chinese: 现在，我的最后一个问题：我们该如何为未来做准备？

sentences.content: It’s simple.
sentences.english: It's simple
sentences.chinese: 很简单。

sentences.content: Just accept change.
sentences.english: Just accept change
sentences.chinese: 坦然接受变化。

sentences.content: Keep learning and working hard.
sentences.english: Keep learning and working hard
sentences.chinese: 持续学习，努力工作。

sentences.content: Today’s choices will influence your future.
sentences.english: Today's choices will influence your future
sentences.chinese: 今日的选择将影响你的未来。

sentences.content: Thank you for your time, Dr Roberts.
sentences.english: Thank you for your time , Dr Roberts
sentences.chinese: 感谢您抽出时间，Roberts博士。
